# Papuma.Kernel

> Document-sourced CQRS kernel for .NET 10, shipped as two independent products
> sharing one model: `Papuma.Kernel` (PostgreSQL >= 18, for servers) and
> `Papuma.Kernel.Local` (SQLite, embedded, no server). JSON documents are the
> source of truth; both derive a reversible change feed automatically, apply
> privacy policies before anything is recorded, support schema evolution and an
> event log. Multi-tenancy is two-layer (predicates + row-level security) on
> Postgres, predicates-only on SQLite (single writer, nothing else to defend
> against). NOT an ORM, NOT event sourcing, NO query DSL.

Reading order for coding agents: start with the playbook (mental model + binding
rules — includes a `Papuma.Kernel.Local` differences section), then
getting-started (API), then concepts (the why), then the ADRs (decisions;
deviations are bugs). The AGENTS.md snippet has one block per kernel — copy the
one matching the consuming application. All canonical documents are English; the
implementation plan and the original design chat remain German (historical
project records), and `docs/vNEXT/concepts.de.md` is a frozen German snapshot of
the concepts document (not maintained).

These files also ship inside the NuGet package under `docs/` — after
`dotnet restore` they are readable locally from the global packages folder
(e.g. `~/.nuget/packages/papuma.kernel/<version>/docs/` for the Postgres kernel,
`~/.nuget/packages/papuma.kernel.local/<version>/docs/` for the SQLite kernel).

## Docs

- [Agent playbook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/papumabiz/Papuma.Kernel/master/docs/ai/papuma-kernel-playbook.md): mental model in 4 sentences, binding ADR rules, API quick map, decision tree, troubleshooting, `Papuma.Kernel.Local` differences
- [AGENTS.md snippet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/papumabiz/Papuma.Kernel/master/docs/ai/papuma-kernel-agents-snippet.md): copy-paste block for AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md of consuming applications — one variant per kernel
- [`Papuma.Kernel.Local` design rationale](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/papumabiz/Papuma.Kernel/master/docs/analyses/local-kernel-sqlite-sibling.md): what's shared code vs. deliberately different per engine, and why
- [Slice conventions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/papumabiz/Papuma.Kernel/master/docs/ai/papuma-kernel-slice-conventions.md): canonical shape of command/view/automation/translation slices — drives scaffolding and code generators
- [Tutorial](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/papumabiz/Papuma.Kernel/master/docs/vNEXT/tutorial.md): learning-oriented, build one app from empty folder to a feed-driven read model (document → session → feed → handler), style-neutral
- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/papumabiz/Papuma.Kernel/master/docs/vNEXT/getting-started.md): bootstrap, write path, handlers, schema evolution in 5 minutes
- [Concepts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/papumabiz/Papuma.Kernel/master/docs/vNEXT/concepts.md): 20 explanatory sections — the "why behind the how" (concurrency, feeds, checkpoints, snapshots, workflows, GDPR)
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/papumabiz/Papuma.Kernel/master/docs/vNEXT/architecture.md): namespaces, SQL data model, write path, ADR index

## Guides

- [Observability](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/papumabiz/Papuma.Kernel/master/docs/vNEXT/observability.md): metrics, tracing, diagnostics APIs, MCP server
- [GDPR tooling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/papumabiz/Papuma.Kernel/master/docs/vNEXT/gdpr.md): data inventory, subject export, history redaction, per-tenant erasure-vs-restriction pattern
- [Recipe: AI consumers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/papumabiz/Papuma.Kernel/master/docs/vNEXT/recipes/ai-consumers.md): pgvector embeddings projection, natural-language audit, anomaly detection
- [Recipe: realtime UI notifications](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/papumabiz/Papuma.Kernel/master/docs/vNEXT/recipes/realtime-ui-notifications.md): NOTIFY-driven UI updates

## Decisions

- [ADR index](https://github.com/papumabiz/Papuma.Kernel/tree/master/docs/vNEXT/adr): 15 ADRs — PostgreSQL-18-only, derived change feed, write path with mandatory expectedVersion, reversible diffs, schema evolution, keys, privacy policies, rollback, feed consumption, gapless reads, event translation, patch primitive, event log, bulk operations, GDPR tooling
